slide3_topic_title: 月度专题深度：当债券不再扮演债券
monthly_conflict_calibration: 长端美债收益率与固收资产校准：研报强调警惕长端美债与久期风险，本组合坚持纯股票高增长架构配搭大华黄金与富敦绝对收益底仓，规避了传统60/40组合在股债正相关环境下的减震失效陷阱。

manager_input.qualitative_view:
【宏观情绪与外围综述 · 9月】美联储开启超预期50基点降息，全球流动性拐点正式确立。中国央行推出强力组合拳（降准、降息与股票回购支持工具），在岸创新龙头与离岸科技股掀起估值修复；但长端国债在通胀粘性担忧下收益率曲线陡峭化，传统债券抗震效果持续衰减。
9月全球市场进入利率博弈与地缘动荡交织期，组合维持底仓绝对收益与高成长哑铃配置，稳健应对外围震荡。9月美联储大幅降息50基点与中国央行强力刺激共振，全球风险偏好急剧抬升。组合底层科技硬件持续受益算力基础设施投资（全球科技+9.20%）；黄金基金在8月单月暴涨24%后9月出现正常利润回吐（-9.92%），大额底仓富敦绝对收益（+0.21%）忠实发挥压舱作用。中国板块当前实际权重12.24%仍高于12.00%目标权重，无需被迫调整，9月维持既有目标配比不变。
manager_input.qualitative_view_en:
【Macro & External Overview · Sep】The Federal Reserve initiated an aggressive 50 bps rate cut, confirming the global liquidity inflection point. The PBOC unleashed a decisive stimulus package (RRR cut, benchmark cuts, and liquidity support for equity repurchases), triggering a sharp valuation rerating across onshore innovation leaders. Concurrently, persistent inflation concerns steepened the US Treasury yield curve, attenuating the traditional shock-absorbing capacity of fixed income.
In September, the portfolio maintained its disciplined barbell allocation: global technology (+9.20%) surged on AI infrastructure CapEx; United Gold (-9.92%) underwent healthy profit consolidation following August's extraordinary +24% rally; and Fullerton Absolute Alpha (+0.21%) faithfully anchored overall portfolio downside. China Innovation stands at 12.24% vs 12.00% target, requiring no forced reduction. Target allocations remain unchanged across all funds.
manager_input.rebalance_note: 各标的底层逻辑稳固，偏离度在安全阈值内，9月维持既有目标配比不变。
manager_input.rebalance_note_en: Core asset theses remain solid; weighting drifts sit comfortably within safety bands. Existing target allocations for all 7 funds remain unchanged for September.
